$comment: What each hosted release declares for every live feature gate the app reads (packages/backend/core/env-manifest.ts liveAppGates; OPERATIONS_BUILD_PROMPTS.md OPS6, PRD-G8). `deno task deploy:check` fails when the env file's value differs from this, or when a gate is missing here. The mock switches (USE_MOCKS, VITE_USE_MOCKS) are not declared: a hosted release never turns them on. Change a value here only as a release decision, in the change that ships it, and say why in its commit. EMBEDDINGS_ENABLED stays false until Voyage's DPA and written no-training terms are signed (Decision #340, ruling T5; providers spec §5).
